title: Augustinus Bader Spa Opens at The Mark Hotel
summary: Described as a "cocoon" by Charles Rosier, cofounder and chief executive officer of the luxury skin care brand, the new space will feature three focus rooms, one with a hyperbaric chamber.
ai_summary: Augustinus Bader Spa opens at The Mark Hotel, described as a "cocoon" by Charles Rosier, featuring three focus rooms including one with a hyperbaric chamber.
